ya10.3.2:1.1: (Ka) yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānittha so domanassindriyaṃ pajahitthāti? Āmantā. (Kha)
ya10.3.2:2.1: yo vā pana domanassindriyaṃ pajahittha so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānitthāti?
ya10.3.2:3.1: Dve puggalā domanassindriyaṃ pajahittha, no ca cakkhundriyaṃ parijānittha. Arahā domanassindriyañca pajahittha cakkhundriyañca parijānittha. (Ka)
